scope: Offline RTL facts and conditional statistical models for fixed N=9.
evidence_notation: Evidence uses source keys above followed by inclusive line ranges.

topology.direction: SYNC/FOLLOW_UP go RIGHT; child receives from LEFT. DELAY_REQ returns LEFT; DELAY_RESP returns RIGHT.
topology.neighbor_validation: Except ARM, left codec requires origin=id-1 and right codec requires origin=id+1.
topology.distance: For one-based module index i: h_i=i-1; p_i=floor(h_i/3); v_i=h_i-p_i.
topology.closing_link: C-to-A returns ARM to M1; the phase parent of M9 remains M8.

estimator.servo_type: Offset steps; frequency step is not servo-adjusted.
estimator.sign_convention: e = child-minus-parent logical-clock error; Delta = child-minus-parent physical marker time.
estimator.first_order_relation: theta_hat = e + (d_forward-d_reverse)/2 + eta; e_after approximately -(d_forward-d_reverse)/2-eta, so Delta gains +(d_forward-d_reverse)/2+eta.
estimator.approximation_conditions: Near-unity rates and fixed mapping during exchange; drift, deferred application and marker sampling add terms.

precision_and_clocks.division: Signed arithmetic shift_right(...,1), not rounding to whole user-clock ticks.
precision_and_clocks.event_capture: Logical timestamps retain fractional bits and are sampled at accepted TX / first valid RX user-clock edges.
precision_and_clocks.marker_grid: Epoch comparison and GPIO registers run on a nominal 16 ns board-clock grid.
precision_and_clocks.shared_clock: Three logical engines share each FPGA user clock; N9 spans three physical PTP clock domains.
precision_and_clocks.drift: Configured per-engine steps emulate relative frequency error. Physical clock jitter is shared within a board; frequency error persists between offset updates.
precision_and_clocks.same_m1: Stable M1 REF/OBS sample the same pulses(0) on the same edge, cancelling common marker quantization.

servo_schedule_and_filter.deferred_apply: Requires parent_state=child_state=0, both TX codecs ready, both request strobes low and data_idle=1.
servo_schedule_and_filter.cascade_implication: A child can track an older parent mapping; instantaneous independent increments are an approximation.
servo_schedule_and_filter.theta_64ns_rejection: abs(theta)>4*C_Q rejection requires NOT G_EXTERNAL_SCHEDULER, so is disabled here.
servo_schedule_and_filter.actual_acceptance_filter: Require path_delay_hat>=0; after8 accepted entries reject abs(path_delay_hat-lower_median(last8))>4ticks (64ns nominal). Equality passes.
servo_schedule_and_filter.lock_rule: Eight stable accepted abs(theta)<=2ticks estimates establish lock; a larger accepted estimate clears stability and runtime lock.
servo_schedule_and_filter.filter_implication: Large directional differential with little sum change can pass the path-delay filter.

link_delay_model.timestamps: TX stamps actual first-word acceptance; RX stamps after receive delay FIFO, so injection affects t2/t4.
link_delay_model.jitter_injection: Per-frame, nonnegative masked-LFSR delay, shared across frame words; not zero-mean Gaussian.
link_delay_model.queues: FIFO order, scheduled release and serialization can correlate delays.

conditional_statistical_model.iid_uniform_assumption: If all four effective errors are independent uniform errors of width q: Var(eta)=q^2/12.
conditional_statistical_model.quantization_caveat: nu is effective event/phase error, not a literal 16 ns timestamp LSB. TX events are clocked; RX sampling/CDC contributes phase. Correlations can cancel or reinforce errors.
conditional_statistical_model.interpretation: Conditional independent-increment/class models. Boundary biases may differ in sign. Fitted spread aggregates effects; timestamp quantization is not separately identified.
conditional_statistical_model.identifiability: Sequential node captures identify marginal means/spreads and effective fits, not cross-node covariance, directional delays or physical causes.
conditional_statistical_model.tails: Report counts, threshold and exposure separately; persistence alone gives no event rate.
